runs.t: Clark Pacific is expanding to the Pacific Northwest — new plant opening Q3 2026.
Our leadership team brings together decades of experience in engineering, manufacturing, and construction — united by a belief that prefabricated systems deliver better buildings.
in every phase of the building process

From structural engineering to plant operations, from sales to sustainability — our executive team has navigated every discipline required to deliver complex prefabricated building systems on demanding schedules.
They share a single conviction: that manufacturing precision, early engagement, and single-source accountability produce fundamentally better buildings than traditional construction.
Hover over a portrait to read a bio.

Ron has led Clark Pacific for over two decades, steering the company's expansion into data centers, building envelope systems, and sustainable construction — while preserving the family culture that has defined the company since 1952.

Brian oversees all plant operations, project delivery, and quality programs across Clark Pacific's four manufacturing facilities, ensuring every project meets the company's standards for precision and on-time performance.
Diane leads financial planning, risk management, and capital investment strategy, supporting Clark Pacific's long-term growth and its expansion into new markets and manufacturing facilities.
Marcus leads a team of structural and design engineers who engage with architects and owners from the earliest project phases — using design-assist to optimize systems before a single panel is cast.

Sarah drives Clark Pacific's market strategy across data centers, building envelope, parking, and structural sectors — building long-term relationships with developers, GCs, and design teams throughout the Western US.
Kevin manages manufacturing across all four plants, with a relentless focus on safety, quality, continuous process improvement, and workforce development at every level of the organization.
Priya leads Clark Pacific's environmental strategy, including EPD publication, low-carbon mix design, green building certification support, and the NetZero Building Platform product roadmap.
James ensures seamless execution from contract award through final inspection — maintaining Clark Pacific's commitment to single-source accountability and client satisfaction on every project.
Chairman, Clark Pacific Board of Directors
We're always looking for talented engineers, project managers, manufacturing professionals, and business leaders who want to build something that matters.
Clark Pacific is a leading manufacturer of prefabricated building systems. We are transforming design and construction by delivering high-quality, cost-effective buildings with less risk.
